channel.title: Sudan - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Sudan, every source cited.

item.title: Sudanese army drone strike kills 36 in Nyala market
item.description: Médecins Sans Frontières reported 150 wounded and widespread devastation after two strikes hit a busy market and a civilian neighborhood.

item.title: UN, France condemn escalating drone attacks in Sudan
item.description: Drone strikes on civilian infrastructure are disrupting essential services and killing civilians, including children.

item.title: China deploys anti-drone systems in Abyei after attack
item.description: Chinese peacekeepers reinforced UNISFA after a drone attack killed UN personnel in the disputed region.

item.title: Sudan war displaces 27,400 families in Blue Nile
item.description: Intense fighting between the Sudanese army, RSF, and SPLA forces has driven thousands to seek shelter in overcrowded camps.
